name: B3·1 Inventory & Rate Ops — low-stock → one-tap PO approval + gold-rate threshold alerts (3 automations combined)

parameters.content:
## ⚙️ SETUP — step by step
1. Tab **Stock**: Item, Karat, WeightG, Qty, MinQty, Supplier, SupplierPhone. Tab **Rates** as in B2·1.
2. Variables: TG_OWNER_CHAT_ID, RATE_ALERT_ABOVE (e.g. 7600), RATE_ALERT_BELOW (e.g. 7100). Attach Telegram + Sheets credentials.
3. **One-tap approval:** the low-stock alert arrives in Telegram with ✅ Approve / ❌ Skip buttons. The `po-approve` webhook receives the tap → drafts the supplier WhatsApp message → sends you the wa.me link to fire it. Activate the workflow FIRST, then copy the `po-approve` Production URL — it is already embedded in the buttons.

## HOW IT RUNS
• Daily 09:15 — every item with Qty ≤ MinQty → Telegram card with approve buttons.
• Tap ✅ → PO text drafted → you get a one-tap wa.me link to the supplier.
• Daily 09:00 + 15:00 — latest rate vs your thresholds → 📈/📉 alert (good for buying decisions & customer messaging).

## 🔧 FIX
• Buttons do nothing → workflow not Active, or webhook URL changed after re-import (re-check the callback_data URL in 'Low-stock alert').
• No rate alerts → Rates tab missing today's row.
